title: Rav Chiyya bar Yehudah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Ketubot 21a, the third of three alternative attributions names Rav Chiyya bar Yehudah as the one who objected to Rav Yehudah: “Did Shmuel say so? But there was that document that came out of Mar Shmuel’s court…” Rav Yehudah answered: “That was an orphan’s document.” Hyman infers from this that Rav Chiyya still knew Shmuel and sat before Rav Yehudah.
